text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Yikes, this is bad! I exceeded my<n>weight class, but
my race is right<n>around the corner! Me too! Ugh, I
hate<n>having to be all careful about my<n>weight and
condition!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Haha. Sorry, but I couldn't help but I<n>overhear your
discussion and woes.<n>Allow me to open your eyes
to some<n>new possibilities.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
If you don't like the work required to<n>lose weight,
then you just have to<n>think of a more entertaining
way to do<n>it!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
First off, let me hear your soul sing!<n>C'mon, feel
the rhythm!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
This place is famous for its fireworks<n>show! Let's
search for an<n>advantageous spot to watch it!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Oh! How about the top of a<n>waterslide? It looks like
we'll have to<n>climb a ton of stairs to get up there,
but let's do it!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Wheeew... That sure was a great<n>detox session at
the spa! Okay, up on<n>our schedule is...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
A dance party! Let's make the most<n>of this
moment! Woohoo!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Haha, incredible! Show me more of<n>what you're
capable of!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl keeps up the pace<n>and in no time
finds herself back in<n>top racing form and physique.
